title: Is Small Language Model the Silver Bullet to Low-Resource Languages Machine Translation?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance using metrics like SPBLEU, CharF++, and LLM-as-a-Judge across 200 languages in the FLORES-200 benchmark to measure the systemic performance gap between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Correlating a country's Human Development Index (HDI) with the LLM-as-a-Judge translation scores of its low-resource languages to identify systemic inequalities and geographic disparities in language model coverage.
